title: Plastics Engineering Technology, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Penn State Erie, The Behrend College -- 2024-25 bulletin. 8-semester Suggested Academic Plan, 134 total credits. Built via bulletin_scraper.py from the live archive page. Identical to 2025-26 curriculum: PSU 7 present in First Year Fall, PLET 227 as generic slot in Third Year Spring, CAS 100 as generic slot in Second Year Fall. No MATH 21/22/81 gap-closing additions detected. Technical and Advanced Technical Electives remain generic slots. [REVIEWER FIX 2026-09-18]: This historical plan as originally built could not schedule CHEM 110/111 (and everything downstream of PLET 205, which requires CHEM 110 concurrently: PLET 222, 206W, 227, 304, 330, 366, 345...) because CHEM 110's real prereq (MATH 22, which needs only MATH 21) was never added, unlike PLETBH-2026.json which already carries this fix. Added MATH 21 and MATH 22 to Semester 1 to close the gap; re-verified with build_full_plan (same-era start_year/today) -- 0 scheduling warnings after the fix. [REVIEWER FIX 2026-09-18]: This year's real bulletin Semester 1 math course is MATH 41 (confirmed via bulletin_scraper.py re-fetch of the archived page -- MATH 81 is genuinely not on this year's printed plan), but MET 111 (Semester 3) and MET 213 (Semester 4) both real-prereq-require MATH 81 or MATH 26, neither of which this plan provided, so those courses could never schedule. PLETBH-2026.json's own Semester 1 already carries MATH 41 AND MATH 81 side by side for exactly this reason. Added MATH 81 to Semester 1 here to match; re-verified with build_full_plan -- 0 scheduling warnings after the fix. [REVIEWER FIX 2026-09-18]: PLET 494A carries a real concurrent-enrollment requirement (MET 418, PLET 350, and PLET 323 all in the same term) in its own catalog entry. Modeling it three times as a plain 'course' item with options=['PLET 494A'] (as originally built) makes build_full_plan's simulation loop forever once those concurrent courses are already completed in an earlier term -- it keeps proposing PLET 494A every subsequent term without ever resolving all three items, hitting the 24-simulated-term cap instead of a clean could-not-schedule warning. PLETBH-2026.json's own plan already avoids this by modeling every PLET 494A occurrence as a generic 'PLET 494A (Plastics Projects)' slot rather than a matched course item; changed this file's three PLET 494A items to match that same precedent. Re-verified with build_full_plan -- 0 scheduling warnings after the fix. (This is a real planner_engine.py scheduling interaction between repeated same-code course items and a concurrent-enrollment requirement -- flagged for the engine reviewers, not patched here.) [REVIEWER FIX 2026-09-18]: PLET 227 was modeled as a generic slot (label only, no course code) even though bulletin_scraper.py confirms it is a real, hyperlinked course on this catalog year's own archived page (Third Year Spring), and PLETBH-2026.json models this exact same requirement as a real course item in the same semester slot. Changed to options=["PLET 227"] to match. This was blocking PLET 330, PLET 366, and PLET 323 (all real-prereq-require PLET 227), which cascaded to PLET 350, PLET 345, and PLET 464. Re-verified with build_full_plan -- 0 scheduling warnings after the fix.
